scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Here is a quick tajweed tip for parents.
When noon or meem has a tashdeed, the sound is held in the nose.
scenes.say: When noon or meem has a tash-deed, the sound is held in the nose.

scenes.sub: Hold it for about two counts. This is called ghunnah.
scenes.say: Hold it for about two counts. This is called ghun-nah.

scenes.sub: Your child practises one rule at a time, aloud, one to one with the teacher.
Then the report shows you which tajweed rule was practised.
